```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
first_record <- 2010L # records cover every FBS season from 2010
first_season <- 2013L
last_season <- 2025L # the 2026 season is still being played
fbs_seasons <- tbl(con, "team_season") |>
  filter(
    classification == "fbs",
    season >= first_record,
    season <= last_season
  ) |>
  collect()
credited <- tbl(con, "team_draft") |>
  filter(
    season >= first_season,
    season <= last_season,
    tier_label != "FCS and below"
  ) |>
  collect()
teams <- tbl(con, "teams") |> collect()
roster <- tbl(con, "roster") |> collect()
picks <- tbl(con, "picks") |> collect()
# Athletes whose outcome is a signing as an undrafted free agent.
udfa_ids <- tbl(con, "outcomes") |>
  filter(outcome_signed_udfa_d) |>
  distinct(playerId) |>
  pull(playerId)
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: compute
#| output: false
school <- school_record(fbs_seasons, credited)
tier_levels <- levels(school$tier)
# Each tier's correlation of a school measure with its draft rate, with the
# plausible range (a 95% confidence interval) for each correlation.
cor_tier <- function(d, x, y) {
  d |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[x]]), !is.na(.data[[y]])) |>
    group_by(tier) |>
    group_modify(\(g, k) {
      ct <- cor.test(g[[x]], g[[y]])
      tibble::tibble(
        schools = nrow(g),
        r = unname(ct$estimate),
        lo = ct$conf.int[1],
        hi = ct$conf.int[2]
      )
    }) |>
    ungroup()
}
# A transfer-in had an earlier roster season at a school other than the one
# they finished at.
exits <- exit_cohort(roster, picks, udfa_ids, reused_ids(roster))
transfer_ids <- exits |>
  select(playerId, final_team = team, last_season) |>
  inner_join(distinct(roster, playerId, season, team), by = "playerId") |>
  filter(season < last_season, team != final_team) |>
  distinct(playerId) |>
  pull(playerId)
fbs_exits <- exits |>
  filter(
    eligible,
    # exits carries its own first_season/last_season columns
    last_season >= .env$first_season,
    last_season <= .env$last_season
  ) |>
  left_join(
    select(fbs_seasons, team, last_season = season, credit_tier = tier_label),
    by = c("team", "last_season")
  ) |>
  filter(credit_tier %in% c("Power", "Group of 5")) |>
  mutate(
    transfer_in = playerId %in% transfer_ids,
    credit_tier = factor(credit_tier, levels = c("Power", "Group of 5"))
  )
# Each school's draft rate with its transfer-ins left out.
home <- fbs_exits |>
  filter(!transfer_in) |>
  group_by(team) |>
  summarise(
    eligible_home = n(),
    drafted_home = sum(drafted),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
school <- school |>
  left_join(home, by = "team") |>
  mutate(rate_home = drafted_home / eligible_home)
win_cor <- cor_tier(school, "win_pct", "draft_rate")
home_cor <- cor_tier(school, "win_pct", "rate_home")
transfer_tier <- fbs_exits |>
  group_by(credit_tier) |>
  summarise(
    eligible = n(),
    eligible_tin = sum(transfer_in),
    drafted = sum(drafted),
    drafted_tin = sum(drafted & transfer_in),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
by_class <- fbs_exits |>
  filter(drafted) |>
  group_by(draft_class, credit_tier) |>
  summarise(
    draftees = n(),
    transfer_ins = sum(transfer_in),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
r_bars <- bind_rows(
  mutate(win_cor, version = "All eligible players"),
  mutate(home_cor, version = "Without transfer-ins")
) |>
  mutate(
    version = factor(version, levels = c("All eligible players", "Without transfer-ins")),
    tier = factor(tier, levels = tier_levels)
  )
r_bars$tip <- paste0(
  r_bars$tier,
  ", ",
  tolower(as.character(r_bars$version)),
  ": r = ",
  sprintf("%.2f", r_bars$r),
  " (plausible range ",
  sprintf("%.2f", r_bars$lo),
  " to ",
  sprintf("%.2f", r_bars$hi),
  ")"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- ggplot(r_bars, aes(r, tier, fill = version)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(tier, version)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8, reverse = TRUE),
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", r)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8, reverse = TRUE),
    hjust = -0.2,
    size = 5.5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("All eligible players" = "#1f2937", "Without transfer-ins" = "#9ca3af"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(tier_levels)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
  labs(
    x = "Correlation of win % with draft rate (r)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Dropping transfer-ins leaves both correlations almost where they were",
    subtitle = "Dark bars: all eligible players; grey bars: transfer-ins left out",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "win-pct-without-transfer-ins", release = release)
card_interactive(p, width_svg = 11, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: explore
p_explore <- by_class |>
  mutate(
    credit_tier = factor(credit_tier, levels = tier_levels),
    tip = paste0(
      credit_tier,
      ", draft class ",
      draft_class,
      ": ",
      transfer_ins,
      " transfer-in draftees of ",
      draftees,
      " draftees"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(draft_class, transfer_ins, fill = credit_tier)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(credit_tier, draft_class)),
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = tier_palette()[tier_levels], name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2010, 2026, 2)) +
  labs(
    x = "Draft class",
    y = "Transfer-in draftees",
    title = "Transfer-in draftees by draft class and tier",
    subtitle = "Each bar is one draft class; hover for the transfer-in and total counts",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
card_interactive(p_explore, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
transfer_tier |>
  left_join(select(win_cor, credit_tier = tier, r_all = r), by = "credit_tier") |>
  left_join(select(home_cor, credit_tier = tier, r_home = r), by = "credit_tier") |>
  transmute(
    Tier = credit_tier,
    `Eligible players` = formatC(eligible, big.mark = ",", format = "d"),
    `Transfer-ins among them` = paste0(
      formatC(eligible_tin, big.mark = ",", format = "d"),
      " (",
      sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * eligible_tin / eligible),
      ")"
    ),
    Drafted = formatC(drafted, big.mark = ",", format = "d"),
    `Transfer-ins among draftees` = paste0(
      formatC(drafted_tin, big.mark = ",", format = "d"),
      " (",
      sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * drafted_tin / drafted),
      ")"
    ),
    `r, win % with draft rate` = sprintf("%.2f", r_all),
    `r, without transfer-ins` = sprintf("%.2f", r_home)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Tier", "Eligible players", "Transfer-ins among them", "Drafted",
      "Transfer-ins among draftees", "r, win % with draft rate",
      "r, without transfer-ins"
    ),
    caption = "Transfer-ins and the win % correlation with and without them, by tier, final seasons 2013 to 2025. Eligible players and draftees are counted in the tier of their final season; the correlations group schools by their school tier."
  )
```
